Root Condition.

dependent upon the fetter of sensual lust, there is the fetter of conceit and the fetter of ignorance; dependent upon the fetter of sensual lust, there is the fetter of ignorance;
dependent upon the fetter of aversion, there is the fetter of envy and the fetter of ignorance.

dependent on the fetter of conceit come the fetters of lust for existence and ignorance;
dependent on the fetter of lust for existence comes the fetter of ignorance; dependent on the fetter of doubt comes the fetter of ignorance.
